description: IBCS variance table with inline bars. One faceted row per service category; bar length = capital $; Actual vs Plan stacked within the row. Page 1 (Income statement explorer). Deneb dataset fields required: service_category_1, scenario, amount. NOT PUBLISHED for the City of Vancouver dataset: no fiscal year carries both an Actual and a Plan (AC=2023-25, PL=2026 never overlap), so this renders blank or as a 3yr-vs-1yr artifact here; kept for a source that has same-period AC+PL. See 09-yoy-plan-vs-actual for the honest year-over-year comparison this data supports.
